nights.title: The Paradox
nights.name: The Paradox
nights.extract: The Paradox is an American pop-punk band from Atlanta, Georgia, formed in 2024. Its members are Eric Dangerfield, Donald Bryant (bass), Christopher "Xelan" Bernard, and Percy "PC3" Crews (drums). They are the first all-black punk band to be number 1 on Billboard's Alternative Airplay chart.
